notes.title: Funded in 4 Hours, - New Unlocked STRETCH GOAL!
notes.content:
Hello [b]RuLovers[/b],

We’re thrilled to announce that, thanks to your amazing support, we’ve surpassed [b]€10,000[/b] in less than 24 hours! This incredible milestone has unlocked the first [b]Stretch Goal[/b], which includes:

- Additional scenes for Chapter 01
- Enhanced storytelling and overall gameplay experience

But the journey doesn’t stop here! Every new milestone we reach will make [b]Love RuRu[/b] even more exciting and special.

📢 Don’t miss out on the exclusive DLC available only to Kickstarter backers!
This unique content will no longer be available once the campaign ends, so make sure to join in and be part of this one-of-a-kind adventure.

👉 Support the campaign on Kickstarter now and help us bring Love RuRu to life!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1993416767/love-ruru

notes.title: Join the Journey: Love RuRu Kickstarter Has Launched!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188503/01ee60fac5e9421eb7a3024433bf78164ae33b22.png[/img]

[h3]The Love RuRu Kickstarter Campaign is LIVE![/h3]

I’m thrilled to share that the Kickstarter campaign for [b]Love RuRu[/b] is live! After two years of intense work and dedication, we’re taking the next big step toward completing the game.

[b]Kickstarter[/b] isn’t just about funding—it’s about bringing you closer to the heart of the project. 

Exclusive rewards like your name in the credits or access to an exclusive DLC are our way of making you an essential part of this journey.

👉 Visit the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1993416767/love-ruru]Kickstarter[/url] campaign to support [b]Love RuRu[/b]. 

Every pledge brings us closer to delivering a game made with love and care.

[b]Thank you[/b] for joining us in making this dream a reality.

notes.title: Step Into the World of Love RuRu
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1993416767/love-ruru][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188503/6bde459e4f19f25d03345a74985382a28a75adbe.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Welcome Friends![/h1]

Here is my first official update on the [b]Steam[/b] page for [b]RWorld: Love RuRu![/b] 
Get ready to dive into a thrilling story filled with captivating girls, intense battles, unexpected twists, and of course, unforgettable [b]HOT[/b] scenes (over [b]50[/b], with many more to come in the final version).

To stay up to date, [b]add[/b] the game to [b]your wishlist[/b] and [b]follow it[/b]. By doing so, you'll receive all the updates directly in your Steam library.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3194150



[h1]Check Out the Trailer[/h1]

Haven’t seen it yet? Go watch the trailer now!

[previewyoutube=AHhp8EEg_mg;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]Kickstarter[/h1]

I've launched the [b]pre-launch campaign on Kickstarter![/b] 
[b]Sign up[/b] now to get an [b]exclusive discount[/b] and access to [b]special offers[/b] when the game is released. 

Don’t miss this unique opportunity!
